tools.name: list_loan_products
tools.description: List all available loan products from Acme Financial Services. Returns details such as product name, type, interest rate, term, and eligibility criteria.

tools.name: get_customer_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a customer profile by customer ID. PII protection is handled by Model Armor at the gateway level.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer (e.g. CUST-001)

tools.name: check_market_rates
tools.description: Fetch current market benchmark rates from Freddie Mac, Federal Reserve, and Bankrate. Compares against Acme internal rates. Subject to Agent Gateway rate-limiting and access policies.

loan_type.description: Filter by category: MORTGAGE, AUTO, PERSONAL, HELOC, REFERENCE, or all

tools.name: run_credit_check
tools.description: Pull a detailed credit report for a customer. SENSITIVE: Returns PII including SSN and date of birth. Model Armor at the Agent Gateway redacts PII before delivery.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer (e.g. CUST-001)

tools.name: assess_fraud_risk
tools.description: Run fraud risk assessment on a loan application. Analyzes against known fraud patterns and returns a scored risk profile. All calls are audit-logged.

application_id.description: The loan application ID to assess (e.g. APP-2026-001)

tools.name: check_regulatory_compliance
tools.description: Validate a loan against federal and state regulatory requirements including TILA, HOEPA, Qualified Mortgage rules, and state usury limits.

loan_type.description: Type of loan: MORTGAGE, AUTO, PERSONAL, or HELOC

annual_rate_percent.description: The annual interest rate as a percentage (e.g. 6.5)

tools.name: update_application_status
tools.description: Update the status of a loan application. WRITE OPERATION: Agent Gateway enforces stricter access controls. All mutations are audit-logged.

application_id.description: The application ID to update (e.g. APP-2026-004)

new_status.description: New status: APPROVED, DENIED, UNDER_REVIEW, WITHDRAWN, or PENDING_DOCS

notes.description: Optional notes about the status change

tools.name: get_property_valuation
tools.description: Look up property valuation from external assessment service. Returns estimated market value, comparable sales, and confidence level. Cross-service authorization via Agent Identity required.

address.description: Optional street address for a more precise match
